_comment: Hook targets, identified by the class header and method signature exactly as
Il2CppDumper prints them in dump.cs. scripts/resolve_targets.py turns this into a
per-build table (RVA, length, code fingerprint). Obfuscated names are fixed per
release and shared with the PC build of the same release; when rebasing, re-check
each one against the PC decompile and update the signature here.

targets.why: Rewrites <service>.rec.net hosts to <service>.<ServerHost> before a request is queued.
Logs each finished request's status (and the body of non-2xx responses).
Returns the operator's Meta app id when OculusAppId is set.
Same as get_AppID; the Quest build reads this getter.
Builds Photon.Realtime.AppSettings with Rec Room's hardcoded Realtime/Voice app ids (PC: same class+method). Postfixed to set the operator's ids.
